summary: Compute explainable reputation signals from moderated evidence
description: Aggregate independent, recent evidence without allowing lookup counts to influence risk.
acceptance: R-1: Every label exposes confidence, reasons, evidence diversity, freshness, and residual uncertainty.
R-2: Lookup volume, raw popularity, and a single unverified report cannot produce a fraud verdict.
R-3: Eligible independent observations can form an explainable, freshness-bounded campaign record without asserting caller identity.

review_history.evidence: Approved after aggregation and schema review: all four labels are independently explainable; source independence and verified community eligibility are enforced; popularity and one unverified report are invariant negatives; campaign output remains deterministic, freshness-bounded, correction-aware, and spoofing-safe; full gate is green.
